scope: Same labels as D=Yd and E=Ye^T at 10 PeV; canonical tagged GJ family coordinates and the registered one-loop running down to the 7.171 TeV threshold. Color-only, full multiplet with inactive lepton mixing, and full multiplet with the same two right/left projections are different models. All initial measured inputs and the registered two effective Majorana source terms and couplings are retained in the original mother shooting prescription. Solar re-normalization is disclosed separately. The independently tagged transport, the common factor test, and invariant all-J matching comparisons have different scopes.
